clusters.rule: Do not perform per-row database work inside a loop over DAGs, task instances or task-map entries: hoist the query outside the loop, batch it, or pass the already-fetched data in; if the data comes from a SQLAlchemy relationship, eager-load it instead of touching the attribute lazily inside the loop.
clusters.trigger: A session.scalars()/session.execute()/session.scalar() call, or a dotted lazy relationship access (e.g. record.dataset.uri), appears inside a for-loop over dags_needing_dagruns, dataset_triggered_dag_info, or mapped task instances.

clusters.rule: In hot-path queries, select only the columns actually used rather than the whole ORM entity: grid and UI endpoints must enumerate their columns instead of select(TaskInstance)/select(DagRun), and with_row_locks selects must fetch only the primary key when only the id is used.
clusters.trigger: A query on a grid/UI endpoint uses select(SomeModel) instead of listing columns, or a with_row_locks(select(AssetModel).where(...)) retrieves the full model when only .id is consumed.

clusters.rule: In SQLAlchemy 2.0 declarative models the Mapped[...] annotation is authoritative for nullability: it must agree with the column's nullable setting, and a redundant nullable=True kwarg must not be passed alongside Mapped[X | None].
clusters.trigger: A mapped_column(...) carries nullable=True while its annotation is Mapped[X | None], or a Mapped[X | None] annotation sits on a column declared nullable=False (or vice versa).

clusters.rule: A database migration shipped in a patch release may only repair a bug in an existing migration; it must not change payload semantics such that users who already ran the original upgrade end up in a different state from a fresh install.
clusters.trigger: A patch-release PR modifies a file under migrations/versions/ and changes upgrade()/downgrade() logic beyond a no-op correction.

clusters.rule: Auth-manager documentation must reference get_url_refresh() for the token-refresh endpoint rather than hardcoding a literal path such as POST /auth/token/refresh.
clusters.trigger: Documentation hardcodes an auth token refresh URL path instead of pointing at the get_url_refresh method.

clusters.rule: is_authorized_* methods on BaseAuthManager and its subclasses must take the generic auth-user type-var (user: T) and express multiple user ids as set[str]; they must not accept concrete Airflow model types such as HITLUser.
clusters.trigger: An is_authorized_* method is added or modified on an auth manager taking a concrete Airflow model type instead of user: T or primitives.

clusters.rule: Extend an existing is_authorized_* method with an optional parameter rather than adding a parallel is_authorized_<action>_for_<entity> method to the BaseAuthManager interface.
clusters.trigger: A new method matching is_authorized_.*_for_ is added to BaseAuthManager.

clusters.rule: Resolve the authenticated user through resolve_user_from_token (core_api/security.py) rather than calling get_auth_manager().get_user_from_token directly from middleware or route code.
clusters.trigger: A direct get_auth_manager().get_user_from_token( call appears outside resolve_user_from_token.

clusters.rule: Keyset cursor pagination over a nullable sort column must use null-aware comparisons (an IS NULL tie-break or COALESCE) that match the ORDER BY null-ordering semantics.
clusters.trigger: Cursor code appends and_(*eq_conditions, col > value) for a column that can be NULL without an IS NULL guard.

clusters.rule: Use if/elif rather than consecutive if statements for the mutually exclusive lower_bound / lower_bound_excluded filter branches so the query does not emit redundant WHERE clauses.
clusters.trigger: Two consecutive `if self.value and self.value.lower_bound...` blocks appear for bound conditions that cannot both apply.

clusters.rule: Annotate DAG-bearing attributes in API parameter and datamodel classes as SerializedDAG (imported under TYPE_CHECKING from airflow.serialization.serialized_objects) rather than Any.
clusters.trigger: A property or attribute in a parameter/datamodel class is typed None | Any where the value is a serialized DAG.

clusters.rule: Queries built from _RegexParam must be wrapped with apply_regex_query_timeout, and the _RegexParam docstring must state that obligation.
clusters.trigger: A route uses _RegexParam or regex_param_factory without a corresponding apply_regex_query_timeout call, or a _RegexParam class/factory has no docstring warning about it.

clusters.rule: Boolean timetable properties consumed by the API (e.g. is_backfillable) must be persisted as a DagModel column via a migration, not derived at runtime by matching timetable_summary strings.
clusters.trigger: A frozenset of timetable summary strings is used in a datamodel or route to derive a boolean DAG property instead of reading a DagModel column.

clusters.rule: When redacting a dict value in an API response serializer, keep it a JSON-serialisable dict rather than wrapping the result in str().
clusters.trigger: str(redact(value)) where value is a dict in a Pydantic response serializer or validator.

clusters.rule: Define callback-definition objects such as _ImportPathCallbackDef in the domain model module (e.g. models/test_connection.py) rather than constructing them inline in a route handler.
clusters.trigger: An _ImportPathCallbackDef or ExecutorCallback construction is inlined inside a route handler body.

clusters.rule: Cursor-paginated endpoints must fetch limit+1 rows to detect whether another page exists, and return next_cursor as null when it does not.
clusters.trigger: A paginated endpoint computes next_cursor/previous_cursor from the current page slice without fetching a probe row.

clusters.rule: PATCH routes that honour update_mask must return HTTP 422 when a field named in update_mask has a null value in the request body.
clusters.trigger: A PATCH handler iterates fields_to_update/update_mask without validating that each included field carries a non-null value.

clusters.rule: Do not add CASE expressions to a query's ORDER BY to force NULL ordering; rely on the database's default NULL ordering so the sort can use an index.
clusters.trigger: A SQLAlchemy query adds a CASE expression in ORDER BY to place NULLs first or last.

clusters.rule: Every new router included in the execution API's authenticated_router must have a matching endpoint(...).didnt_exist entry in the unreleased Cadwyn version file.
clusters.trigger: A new router is added to authenticated_router.include_router() in execution_api/routes/__init__.py with no corresponding didnt_exist entry in versions/v*.py.

clusters.rule: A new state table keyed on an asset must come with a decided lifecycle for its rows when the corresponding AssetActive row is removed - a cascade delete or an explicit GC policy - not unbounded accumulation.
clusters.trigger: A new asset_state table/model is introduced with no cascade-delete from AssetActive removal and no GC policy.

clusters.rule: Do not add a field to a Pydantic response model whose name is the singular or plural variant of an existing field unless the two have clearly distinct, documented semantics.
clusters.trigger: A Pydantic model gains a field whose name is the plural (or singular) form of an existing field, e.g. partition_key alongside partition_keys.

clusters.rule: Do not drive a single-item state operation through the bulk service interface; use the single-item service code path.
clusters.trigger: A non-bulk route instantiates a BulkService with a dummy empty BulkBody to perform a single-item update.

clusters.rule: Use session.flush() rather than session.commit() inside a method that participates in a larger task-completion transaction, such as register_asset_change.
clusters.trigger: session.commit() is added or kept inside register_asset_change or another method invoked as part of a multi-model task-completion transaction.

clusters.rule: When an AssetEvent must be visible before the caller's transaction commits, open an independent session with create_session(scoped=False) rather than committing the shared session.
clusters.trigger: A create_session call appears near AssetEvent insertion, or session.commit() is swapped for a separate session block in assets/manager.py.

clusters.rule: Do not call session.flush() from a finally or except block reached on an error path.
clusters.trigger: session.flush() is added inside a finally: or except: clause in an asset or scheduler code path.

clusters.rule: Execution-API list endpoints that query the metadata database must apply pagination (limit/offset) or a documented hard cap.
clusters.trigger: A GET list route in the execution API calls session.scalars(stmt).all() with no limit or offset.

clusters.rule: Do not define domain-model enums (e.g. WeightRule) in configuration.py; put them in the module that owns the concept.
clusters.trigger: A class definition for an Enum or domain type is added to airflow-core/src/airflow/configuration.py.

clusters.rule: Expose internal collections from AirflowConfigParser through methods returning immutable sequences (tuple), not as mutable list properties.
clusters.trigger: A @property in AirflowConfigParser or a subclass is annotated as returning list[...].

clusters.rule: Type warning_types-style parameters as an open-ended homogeneous tuple (tuple[DagWarningType, ...]) rather than a fixed-length tuple.
clusters.trigger: A parameter typed tuple[DagWarningType, DagWarningType] is added or modified in dag_processing/collection.py.

clusters.rule: When a parameter of DagBag or DagBag.collect_dags stops being used, either remove it from the signature and docstring entirely or emit a UserWarning when it is supplied; do not silently ignore it.
clusters.trigger: A DagBag.__init__ or DagBag.collect_dags parameter is dropped from the implementation body but kept in the signature or docstring.

clusters.rule: Do not rely on a SQLAlchemy UPDATE returning rowcount == 0 to detect a missing row; use an explicit SELECT or EXISTS check.
clusters.trigger: `if result.rowcount == 0: raise` follows a single-row update() call.

clusters.rule: Implement new executor workload features in BaseExecutor or a shared mixin so each concrete executor does not have to be updated individually.
clusters.trigger: A new workload-handling method or branch is added to multiple concrete executor files (local_executor.py, celery_executor.py, ...) with no base-class implementation.

clusters.rule: In prepare_file_queue, look file stats up through the pre-built presence_key index dict in O(1) rather than scanning _file_stats linearly per file.
clusters.trigger: dag_processing/manager.py builds a dict keyed by file.presence_key but then calls a helper (e.g. processed_recently) that iterates over _file_stats.

clusters.rule: Do not add a separate query for an individual task state inside the scheduler critical section; fold the new state condition into the existing query.
clusters.trigger: A new session.execute(select(...).where(TI.state == ...)) is added inside _critical_section_* or an adjacent scheduler method.

clusters.rule: Prefer a ~exists(select(...).where(...)) anti-join over <col>.not_in(select(...)) in ORM queries.
clusters.trigger: The diff contains .not_in(select(...)) or NOT IN (SELECT ...) in a SQLAlchemy query.

clusters.rule: A foreign-key column used as a subquery filter predicate in scheduler queries must have an explicit Index(...) declaration unless an existing index is confirmed to cover it.
clusters.trigger: A subquery filter on an FK column (e.g. .where(<Model>.trigger_id == ...)) is added with no Index("idx_<table>_<column>", ...) in the model definition.

clusters.rule: To call get_template_context from the triggerer, construct a RuntimeTaskInstance via RuntimeTaskInstance.model_construct(...); do not call it on a plain TaskInstance.
clusters.trigger: .get_template_context() is called on an airflow.executors.workloads TaskInstance inside the triggerer job runner.

clusters.rule: An Alembic upgrade() must not DELETE or truncate existing rows in place of a data-preserving migration; a bare DELETE FROM with a TODO is not acceptable.
clusters.trigger: op.execute("DELETE FROM ...") is added in an upgrade() function alongside a "# TODO: Implement data-preserving migration" comment.

clusters.rule: An expires_at column in an Airflow state or retention table must mean "never expires" when NULL, and its GC query must be a single `WHERE expires_at < now()` predicate rather than a two-path check mixing updated_at with a default retention config.
clusters.trigger: An expires_at column is added whose NULL is documented as "use default retention", with a GC query combining expires_at and updated_at + config conditions.

clusters.rule: Route SQLAlchemy 1.4/2.0 compatibility shims through airflow.utils.sqlalchemy rather than inline try/except ImportError blocks in individual model files.
clusters.trigger: A model file adds a try/except ImportError block to shim mapped_column or Mapped from sqlalchemy.orm instead of importing from airflow.utils.sqlalchemy.

clusters.rule: Validate user-supplied DAG run configuration with dag.params.deep_merge(dag_run_conf).validate() before starting a backfill.
clusters.trigger: A backfill code path passes dag_run_conf to create_dagrun (or similar) without first calling dag.params.deep_merge(...).validate().

clusters.rule: Write SQLAlchemy type constructors as instantiated calls in mapped_column and in Alembic migrations - sa.JSON() rather than sa.JSON.
clusters.trigger: mapped_column(sa.JSON, ...) or Column(sa.JSON, ...) appears without parentheses on the type.

clusters.rule: Prefix module-internal helper functions with an underscore so they do not become part of the public API surface.
clusters.trigger: A new module-level function is added in airflow-core without a leading underscore but referenced only within the same file or package.

clusters.rule: Every cache hit path - including the double-checked-locking fast path - must increment Stats.incr("api_server.dag_bag.cache_hit").
clusters.trigger: A double-checked locking block or secondary fast path returns a cached DAG without calling Stats.incr("api_server.dag_bag.cache_hit").

clusters.rule: Bound DAG cache TTLs to min_serialized_dag_update_interval rather than an arbitrary shorter value.
clusters.trigger: A DAG bag or serialized-DAG cache introduces a TTL constant or parameter that neither references nor defaults to min_serialized_dag_update_interval.

clusters.rule: Do not call session.flush() midway through a write_dag unit of work; add every related object to the session first and flush once at the end.
clusters.trigger: A session.flush() call appears mid-function inside write_dag or a similar multi-object DB write, before all related objects have been added.

clusters.rule: TaskGroup.topological_sort() must not rebuild the DAG-level group mapping on each recursive call; build it once and pass it into nested calls.
clusters.trigger: topological_sort() in taskgroup.py constructs a group-lookup dict in its body instead of accepting one as a parameter.

clusters.rule: Do not open a new create_session block inside a method that already has a session or can delegate to an existing model query method (e.g. XComModel.get_many) that accepts one.
clusters.trigger: A `with create_session()` block is added inside a method that already has access to a session parameter.

clusters.rule: Detect in-memory SQLite in engine-configuration code by parsing the SQLAlchemy URL (dialect plus database target), not by string comparison against "sqlite://" or "sqlite:///:memory:".
clusters.trigger: In-memory SQLite is tested with == or in against the string literals "sqlite://" or "sqlite:///:memory:".

clusters.rule: State-store write methods must use a single database-level UPSERT (INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE) rather than a SELECT followed by an INSERT.
clusters.trigger: A state-write method does session.get(...) or a SELECT and then session.add(row) for the same primary or unique key.

clusters.rule: Public method overrides on Timetable subclasses must carry an explicit return-type annotation.
clusters.trigger: A public method is added or overridden on a Timetable subclass with no -> ReturnType annotation.

clusters.rule: Do not add __all__ when the module already re-exports symbols with the `import X as X` pattern; that form is the single authoritative re-export mechanism in airflow-core.
clusters.trigger: A file adds both `from module import Foo as Foo` and lists Foo in __all__.

clusters.rule: Do not add a public property to CronMixin or another core timetable base class solely to serve SDK-side consumers; core public API must have at least one in-core consumer.
clusters.trigger: A @property is added to CronMixin or another core timetable base class with no reference site in airflow-core.

clusters.rule: Prefer icons from react-icons over custom inline SVG in the Airflow UI; add a custom icon only when react-icons has no suitable option.
clusters.trigger: A new custom icon component (createIcon({...}) or a raw <svg>) is added under ui/src/assets/ or ui/src/components/.

clusters.rule: Pass only the i18n namespaces a file actually uses to useTranslation.
clusters.trigger: A useTranslation([...]) call lists namespaces that the file's translate calls never reference.

clusters.rule: Normalise response shapes and map fields in the backend API so it returns one consistent response type; do not re-shape API responses in frontend components.
clusters.trigger: A frontend component destructures and rebuilds an API response object to normalise its shape.

clusters.rule: Sync async-loaded data into react-hook-form fields with the useForm({ values: ... }) option rather than a useEffect that calls reset() or setValue().
clusters.trigger: A useEffect calls form.reset() or form.setValue() to populate fields after an async fetch resolves.

clusters.rule: DagVersion and BundleVersion must be represented by visually distinct icons in the UI.
clusters.trigger: DagVersionIndicator and BundleVersionIndicator (or equivalent components) render the same icon.

clusters.rule: Do not wrap a single stable function delegation in useCallback with an empty dependency array in the Airflow UI; pass the stable reference directly.
clusters.trigger: useCallback(() => stableFn(arg), []) is added where stableFn is already stable and the wrapper adds no logic.

clusters.rule: Shared literal constants in the Airflow UI (localStorage keys, gradients, pixel offsets, colours) must live in a `constants.ts` module — the global `src/constants/` one for cross-cutting keys, the feature folder's own for feature-local values — not inline in components.
clusters.trigger: A `.tsx` component defines or inlines a string/number literal (localStorage key, gradient string, pixel offset) that is also used by another component instead of importing it from a constants module.

clusters.rule: Use the OpenAPI-generated react-query hooks for all API calls in the UI; do not write raw `fetch` calls with manually encoded query strings.
clusters.trigger: diff adds `fetch(`${OpenAPI.BASE}...`)` or manual `encodeURIComponent`/`join("&")` query construction in `airflow-core/src/airflow/ui/src/queries/`.

clusters.rule: Do not prop-drill URL search-param values (e.g. `tryNumber`) through multiple component levels; read them directly from `useSearchParams` in the consuming component.
clusters.trigger: diff threads a value that originates from the URL through one or more intermediate component props.

clusters.rule: When a component queries with a hard `limit`, compare `total_entries` against the limit and give the user a way to see the remainder (e.g. a '+ N more' modal) rather than silently truncating.
clusters.trigger: diff adds a component that renders a limited list without any affordance for the case `total_entries > limit`.

clusters.rule: Filter inputs that are redundant in a context-specific view (e.g. a DAG ID filter on a page where `dagId` is already in the URL path) must be hidden by conditional rendering.
clusters.trigger: diff reuses a shared filters component on a scoped page without conditionally hiding the filter that the route already fixes.

clusters.rule: Group a feature's sub-components in a named folder (e.g. `TaskFilters/`) with a single barrel export, and import only the folder's root component from outside.
clusters.trigger: diff adds an import that reaches into a feature folder for a non-root sub-component.

clusters.rule: A new Alembic migration must add its `_REVISION_HEADS_MAP` entry for the next unreleased Airflow version, and the map must stay monotonic: each version's head must chain back through the previous version's head, never to a later revision.
clusters.trigger: diff adds a migration under `airflow/migrations/` without a `_REVISION_HEADS_MAP` entry, or adds/edits an entry under an already-released version key or one whose `down_revision` does not follow the previous head.

clusters.rule: Mermaid initialisation in the Airflow UI must be owned by a React context provider under `src/context`, not by a module-level mutable variable.
clusters.trigger: diff adds or modifies mermaid initialisation outside `airflow-core/src/airflow/ui/src/context/`.

clusters.rule: Enums that DAG authors in other languages must understand (WeightRule, TriggerRule, and similar) must be defined in the ExecAPI OpenAPI spec, not shared through Python code or `airflow-shared`.
clusters.trigger: diff moves or adds an Airflow enum to `airflow-shared/`, or imports one from there in task-SDK or provider code.

clusters.rule: Use `session.scalar(select(Model).where(...))` / `session.scalars(...)` instead of the legacy `session.query(Model).filter(...)` ORM style.
clusters.trigger: diff adds `session.query(...).filter(...)` in source or test code.

clusters.rule: When an execution-API feature claims multi-backend support through SQLAlchemy constructs such as `regexp_match`, its tests must run against every claimed backend, not just Postgres.
clusters.trigger: diff adds tests marked only `@pytest.mark.backend("postgres")` for a backend-portable construct.

clusters.rule: The Helm OTel collector ConfigMap must expose a values key that lets users supply their own complete collector `config.yml` instead of only the Airflow-generated body.
clusters.trigger: diff adds an OTel collector ConfigMap template with no `.Values` override for the whole config body.

clusters.rule: In Helm Service templates, name the user-supplied annotations key `.Values.<component>.service.annotations` (not `extraAnnotations`) when the resource has no Airflow-generated annotations of its own.
clusters.trigger: diff introduces `.Values.<component>.service.extraAnnotations` on a Service where no Airflow-generated annotations are applied.

clusters.rule: In `topological_sort` and other task-group ordering paths, index positions with a `dict[task_id, index]` rather than repeated `list.index()` lookups.
clusters.trigger: diff introduces or retains a `.index(` call on a list inside a topological-sort or task-group ordering function.

clusters.rule: Breeze utility functions must not mix human-readable error sentinel strings into a `list[str]` of job names; signal lookup failure with `None`, a result object, or an exception.
clusters.trigger: A function returning `list[str]` (or a similar job-name collection) returns a string constant such as `FAILED_JOBS_LOOKUP_ERROR` on failure.

clusters.rule: Breeze `CacheStore` entries must nest the stored payload under a dedicated key (e.g. `{"profile": ...}`) so cache metadata such as `cached_at` never leaks into the runtime object returned to callers.
clusters.trigger: A `CacheStore.save()` stores a plain dict and the matching `get()` result is used directly as the runtime object.

clusters.rule: Go IPC message structs that use `-1` as a sentinel for `map_index` must document the convention in a comment, and should prefer a nullable `*int` to match the Python side's `int | None`.
clusters.trigger: diff adds a Go IPC struct with an `int` `MapIndex` field using -1 as a sentinel while the Python counterpart in `comms.py` uses `int | None`.

clusters.rule: An AWS operator's `execute()` should return a minimal meaningful identifier (ARN, URI, name) rather than the raw boto3 response dict.
clusters.trigger: diff ends an AWS operator's `execute()` with `return response` where `response` is the raw boto3 response.

clusters.rule: When replacing a deprecated parameter with a version-gated successor, translate the deprecated parameter's value automatically for runtimes below the required version instead of forcing users to switch names.
clusters.trigger: diff deprecates parameter A and adds replacement B that only works on Airflow >= X.Y, with no fallback making B behave like A below X.Y.

clusters.rule: Do not change the default value of an existing operator or hook parameter used by pre-existing code paths; a new path may enforce its own floor (e.g. with `max()`), but the legacy default must stay as it was.
clusters.trigger: diff changes the default of an `__init__` parameter (e.g. `status_poll_interval`) that pre-existing execution paths already use.

clusters.rule: Provider secrets-backend classes must implement only the methods declared on `BaseSecretsBackend`; do not add extra public methods (e.g. `get_config`) absent from the base interface.
clusters.trigger: A class extending `BaseSecretsBackend` defines a public method not present in `airflow/secrets/base_secrets.py`.

clusters.rule: Provider factory mappings keyed by enum members must be annotated `dict[EnumType, ...]`, and public entry points must accept both the enum and a string, normalising strings with an informative `ValueError`.
clusters.trigger: A `_providers` dict annotated `dict[str, type]` is keyed with enum instances, or a factory accepts only the enum where callers pass strings from connection config or YAML.

clusters.rule: Reuse the shared exception types from `providers/standard/exceptions.py` (e.g. `HITLRejectException`) instead of defining a per-provider duplicate for the same semantic error.
clusters.trigger: A provider defines a new exception class duplicating the purpose of one already in `providers/standard/exceptions.py`.

clusters.rule: Provider operator methods that iterate over connection IDs must use the class's cached hook mapping (e.g. `self._db_hooks[conn_id]`) rather than constructing a hook on each iteration.
clusters.trigger: A loop over connection IDs calls a factory such as `self._get_db_hook(conn_id)` inside the loop while a cached property already exists on the class.

clusters.rule: Use `Literal[...]` for Pydantic model fields whose valid values are an enumerable set of strings; do not encode the constraint only in the field description.
clusters.trigger: A Pydantic `Field(description='One of: ...')` or plain `str` field whose accepted values are a fixed, enumerable set

clusters.rule: Do not collapse `None` to an empty container with `param or []` in an operator `__init__` when the empty value has distinct meaning in the downstream API call; keep `None` and the empty list distinguishable.
clusters.trigger: `self.param = param or []` in an operator `__init__` where `param` is forwarded to an external API and an explicit empty list means something (e.g. clearing permissions)

clusters.rule: When a FastAPI route can raise a new HTTP status code, add that code to the route decorator's `responses=` mapping.
clusters.trigger: A `raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_4xx_...)` in a handler body whose decorator does not list that status in `responses=`

clusters.rule: FastAPI `Query`/parameter descriptions in provider routes must describe what the implementation actually accepts (e.g. do not advertise comma-separated multi-field ordering when only a single field is supported).
clusters.trigger: A `Query(..., description=...)` string in a provider route that promises behaviour the handler does not implement

clusters.rule: FastAPI route handlers in provider packages must carry an explicit return type annotation matching the decorator's `response_model`.
clusters.trigger: A handler declared with `response_model=Foo` but no `-> Foo` return annotation

clusters.rule: A SQLAlchemy `before_create` DDL event listener must not permanently mutate shared metadata such as `table.indexes`; express dialect differences with dialect-scoped DDL that adds or skips instead of discarding.
clusters.trigger: `table.indexes.discard(...)` / `.remove(...)` inside an `@event.listens_for(Table, 'before_create')` listener

clusters.rule: Keep the public surface of provider operators, hooks and extractors backward compatible: a changed return value, changed traversal, or new constructor keyword must be opt-in via a new parameter defaulting to the legacy behaviour, and existing public signatures (e.g. `BaseExtractor.__init__(self, operator)`) must keep working.
clusters.trigger: A diff that changes an existing operator's `execute()` return shape, alters what an existing hook method traverses or returns, or passes a new required keyword to a subclass constructor unconditionally

clusters.rule: Pass camelCase REST API field names (e.g. `definitionBody`, `routineType`) — not Python SDK attribute names (`body`, `type_`) — in the `fields`/update-mask argument of Google client update methods.
clusters.trigger: A writable-properties constant built from Python attribute names and passed as `fields` to a Google client update call

clusters.rule: A `ClassVar` dict used as an in-process cache in a provider utility is acceptable because provider worker processes are short-lived.
clusters.trigger: A reviewer questioning whether a `ClassVar[dict]` cache in a provider utility can grow unboundedly

clusters.rule: A retryable-error tuple in the Postgres hook must list the narrowest psycopg exception subclasses (e.g. `UndefinedColumn`, `UndefinedTable`) from the matching package — `psycopg` for v3, `psycopg2` for v2 — never a broad class such as `OperationalError`.
clusters.trigger: A `_POSTGRES_RETRYABLE_ERRORS` tuple containing `OperationalError` or another broad psycopg exception class

clusters.rule: Extract repeated `str | datetime | None` type-dispatch into a shared utility rather than duplicating the `isinstance` block per method.
clusters.trigger: The same `isinstance(value, (str, datetime.datetime))` dispatch block repeated in more than one method

clusters.rule: Insert new entries into `airflow/sdk/__init__.py`'s `__all__` and lazy-import dict in alphabetical position, not appended at the end.
clusters.trigger: A symbol added to `__all__` or the lazy-import dict in `task-sdk/src/airflow/sdk/__init__.py` out of alphabetical order

clusters.rule: Language-agnostic coordinator plumbing — `_start_server`, `_accept_connections`, socketpair setup — belongs in `BaseCoordinator`, not duplicated in each per-language coordinator.
clusters.trigger: A new coordinator under `task-sdk/src/airflow/sdk/coordinators/` re-implementing socket server startup or accept helpers that are not runtime-specific

clusters.rule: A language coordinator's constructor arguments need only make sense for its own runtime; do not copy another coordinator's argument names or types for the sake of symmetry.
clusters.trigger: A coordinator given argument names or types mirroring a different language's coordinator rather than idiomatic ones for its runtime

clusters.rule: Do not define a `__version__` attribute inside `airflow.sdk.coordinators.*` sub-packages; the distribution version is exposed only as `airflow.sdk.__version__`.
clusters.trigger: A `__version__ = "..."` assignment or `"__version__"` in `__all__` under `task-sdk/src/airflow/sdk/coordinators/*/`

clusters.rule: A concrete Task SDK class exported from the public API must implement every abstract method of its base (including `to_upstream()` on partition mappers); leave it abstract or unexported until it does.
clusters.trigger: A concrete mapper under `task-sdk/src/airflow/sdk/definitions/partition_mappers/` inheriting `RollupMapper` without overriding `to_upstream()`

clusters.rule: New language-SDK task registration APIs should follow the two-step registration the Java and Go SDKs use — define the callable, then register the task against a Dag — so Dag-level arguments remain expressible; an inline `registerTask({dagId, taskId}, fn)` must be justified against that path.
clusters.trigger: A task registration entrypoint added or documented under `ts-sdk/` that binds dagId and taskId inline in one call

clusters.rule: Any query whose rows are dereferenced through an ORM relationship inside the scheduler loop must eagerly load that relationship (e.g. `joinedload(DatasetEvent.dataset)`); default lazy loading is not acceptable there
clusters.trigger: Scheduler-loop code builds a set or log line by accessing `event.dataset.uri`, `record.dag.<attr>` or similar on rows from a query carrying no `joinedload`/`selectinload` option

clusters.rule: When dropping a `needs:` gate to parallelise a release workflow, split the publish/sync steps into a job that still `needs:` the gating job instead of discarding the ordering guarantee outright
clusters.trigger: A job in a release workflow has its `needs:` replaced (e.g. `needs: [publish-docs-to-s3, build-info]` becomes `needs: [build-info, build-ci-image]`) while it still contains sync or publish steps that must not land before the gating job

clusters.rule: Profiling and other developer-only libraries (e.g. `memray`) must be declared as an optional extra in `airflow-core/pyproject.toml`, never appended to the mandatory `dependencies` list
clusters.trigger: A diff adds an entry to the top-level `dependencies = [...]` array in `airflow-core/pyproject.toml` for a tool that only some users need

clusters.rule: Any new public method added to BaseAuthManager that introduces user-facing behaviour must be accompanied by a newsfragment and a defined default behaviour for auth managers that do not override it
clusters.trigger: New method added to BaseAuthManager (or subclass) without a newsfragment file and without a documented/implemented default fallback

clusters.rule: The API representation of infinite pool slots must use -1, not None; JSON cannot represent float('inf') and None conflicts with the existing API spec for open slots
clusters.trigger: Serialiser or Pydantic validator converts float('inf') pool slots to None before returning an API response

clusters.rule: List routes in the FastAPI core API must use the paginated_select convention for all DB-backed collections; omitting pagination on a collection endpoint is not acceptable
clusters.trigger: New GET list route in api_fastapi/core_api/routes/public/ returns all rows via session.scalars(select(...)).all() without calling paginated_select

clusters.rule: Broad AirflowException catches at route boundaries must not forward arbitrary internal error messages as 4xx detail strings; narrow the catch to user-facing exceptions or validate the message before re-raising
clusters.trigger: except AirflowException as e: raise HTTPException(4xx, str(e)) without narrowing the caught exception type or filtering the message

clusters.rule: Aggregate statistics over DagRun history (durations, averages) must not be computed by fetching unbounded result sets; pre-compute them incrementally or use windowed queries, and confirm migration safety before adding new computed columns
clusters.trigger: select() over DagRun with no row limit used to compute aggregate statistics (avg duration, p90, etc.) in a route handler

clusters.rule: Bulk DAG updates must use a single subquery-based UPDATE (DagModel.dag_id.in_(subquery)) rather than paginated SELECT loops that issue one DB query per page
clusters.trigger: paginated_select or offset/limit loop used to fetch DAG IDs before issuing individual UPDATE statements in a bulk-patch route

clusters.rule: Response models must not include fields already available through a separately fetched resource on the same page; check existing endpoint payloads before adding redundant fields to a datamodel
clusters.trigger: Field added to a Grid/collection response datamodel (e.g. GridRunsResponse) that duplicates data already returned by a companion detail endpoint called by the same UI view

clusters.rule: Do not use runtime `inspect` introspection to discover whether a callable accepts a parameter and pass arguments conditionally; make the parameter-presence decision on the caller side, or fix the caller/test to pass the expected arguments directly
clusters.trigger: inspect.signature() / inspect.Parameter / `'param' in params` used inside BaseAuthManager or a test to decide whether to pass a keyword argument to an override such as an auth-manager method or clear_task_instances

clusters.rule: Config values read inside hot paths (called once per task during scheduling) must be cached at construction time, not re-read on every call
clusters.trigger: conf.get* called inside a method that is invoked per-task or per-DAG-run in the scheduler loop rather than once at object construction

clusters.rule: DataError exception messages surfaced to API clients must be generic enough to cover all possible DataError sub-cases, not worded as if only one specific cause (e.g. text-size overflow) can trigger them
clusters.trigger: HTTPException detail string inside a DataError handler mentions a specific column type (MEDIUMTEXT, LONGTEXT) or a single error cause

clusters.rule: SQLAlchemy JSON column type checks must use isinstance(col.type, JSON) for cross-dialect compatibility; do not add a string-comparison fallback (str(col.type).upper() in ('JSON','JSONB')) unless you can confirm isinstance fails for a specific dialect

clusters.rule: Single-value filter parameters on list endpoints should accept multiple values (list[str] with FilterOptionEnum.ANY_EQUAL) so callers can request several items in one request instead of needing a dedicated GET /{id} endpoint
clusters.trigger: filter_param_factory used with a scalar type (str | None) for a unique-key field (e.g. uri, conn_id) on a list endpoint that could naturally accept multiple values

clusters.rule: Task-group pattern resolution logic invoked from a public API endpoint must reside inside the corresponding QueryTI filter class's to_orm method, not be inlined in the route handler
clusters.trigger: resolve_task_group_pattern_to_task_ids or equivalent task-group expansion code placed directly in a route function rather than in a QueryTI* subclass

clusters.rule: Removing an existing public REST API query parameter is a breaking change; keep the old parameter and add the new one alongside it
clusters.trigger: diff removing a Query parameter (e.g. xcom_key) from a public route that previously exposed it

clusters.rule: Logic used exclusively by a public API endpoint must not be placed under the ui/ service layer; move it to a common or public service module

clusters.rule: Skip calling _serialize_xcoms() entirely when result_task_ids is an empty list; only call it when result_task_ids is None (DAG-authored default) or a non-empty list

clusters.rule: Columns added to SQLAlchemy `load_only()` clauses must be actually accessed by the downstream code that consumes the query result

clusters.rule: A new single-entry config section must not be created as a top-level section in `config.yml`; place the entry in the `core` section following the precedent of `xcom_backend` and similar singleton settings

clusters.rule: Do not add application-level mutex lock tables to guard writes that SQLite already serialises; skip the lock for SQLite backends

clusters.rule: Prefer `session.scalar()` or `session.scalars().one()` over `session.get()` with a composite primary-key dict when querying ORM models

clusters.rule: Do not widen `DagModel` bundle-name queries with `OR bundle_name IS NULL` to paper over missing bundle assignments; instead add an Alembic migration that sets NULL bundle_name to `'dags-folder'` for 2.x-upgraded DAGs
clusters.trigger: A SQLAlchemy query in `dag_processing/manager.py` adds `.or_(DagModel.bundle_name.is_(None))` or equivalent to handle bundle-less DAGs from a 2.x upgrade

clusters.rule: Public methods on `DagProcessorManager` that accept `Iterable[str]` bundle names must guard against a plain `str` argument (iterating characters) by either accepting `str | Iterable[str]` and special-casing strings, or raising `TypeError` when a `str` is received
clusters.trigger: A new public method accepts `bundle_names: Iterable[str]` and calls `.update(bundle_names)` or iterates it without checking `isinstance(bundle_names, str)`

clusters.rule: Only acquire `BundleVersionLock` in the DAG-processing callback path when `request.bundle_version is not None`; skip the lock entirely for non-versioned bundles

clusters.rule: Alembic data migrations must not do per-row work over a whole table: batch UPDATEs into one `conn.execute(update().where(bindparam(...)), [rows])` and stage join keys into a temporary column instead of running a correlated join per row

clusters.rule: A uniqueness invariant that a new ORM model's docstring asserts must be enforced by a database constraint, not by a comment plus a "work on the latest row" fallback

clusters.rule: Invalid user input for backfills must be rejected by the API/UI layer; model-layer helpers must not raise bare `RuntimeError` for request shapes the API should have refused

clusters.rule: Build DagRun lookup statements by conditionally chaining `.where()` for the optional keys (`partition_key`, `logical_date`) and order NULLs with an explicit `col.is_(None)` term instead of the session-taking `nulls_first(..., session=session)` helper

clusters.rule: Methods on the airflow-core ORM `Connection` model must not branch on task-SDK execution state such as `SUPERVISOR_COMMS` on `airflow.sdk.execution_time.task_runner`; SDK-side code holds the SDK's own Connection type, not this ORM object
clusters.trigger: A method in `airflow/models/connection.py` inspects `sys.modules.get("airflow.sdk.execution_time.task_runner")` or otherwise detects whether it is running inside a task supervisor

clusters.rule: Trigger/orphan cleanup queries must express "no referencing row" with a correlated `~exists(select(Child.trigger_id).where(Child.trigger_id == Trigger.id))` rather than `Trigger.id.not_in(select(...))`, and must not carry a redundant `is_not(None)` inside the EXISTS

clusters.rule: A new scheduler Stats counter that records the same information as an existing one must reuse that metric's tag keys (e.g. the tag naming the exception) instead of inventing a second spelling

clusters.rule: Emit Stats.gauge() calls after releasing any cache lock, not while holding it, to minimise lock contention
clusters.trigger: Stats.gauge(...) or Stats.incr(...) call appears inside a `with self._lock:` block in dagbag or similar cache classes

clusters.rule: Use a callable (e.g. `timezone.utcnow`) for SQLAlchemy column `default=` and `onupdate=`, never an evaluated expression like `pendulum.now(tz='UTC')`

clusters.rule: In `__repr__` for models that embed a `Callback` object, delegate to `self.callback` directly rather than manually formatting `callback.path` and `callback.kwargs`
clusters.trigger: f-string in __repr__ that expands self.callback.path and self.callback.kwargs manually instead of using str(self.callback) or {self.callback}

clusters.rule: Use `StringID()` from `airflow.models.base` for `task_id`, `dag_id`, and `run_id` ORM columns instead of the raw `String(ID_LEN, **COLLATION_ARGS)` form
clusters.trigger: mapped_column(String(ID_LEN, **COLLATION_ARGS), ...) for a column named task_id, dag_id, or run_id in any model file

clusters.rule: Internal helper functions in `airflow.models.taskinstance` must be prefixed with `_` to avoid unintentionally expanding the module's public import surface
clusters.trigger: New top-level function added to airflow/models/taskinstance.py without a leading underscore, called only from within the same module

clusters.rule: Never manually edit auto-generated OpenAPI client files (openapi-gen/); all changes must be produced by regenerating via the configured @hey-api/openapi-ts command
clusters.trigger: A diff modifies files under airflow-core/src/airflow/ui/openapi-gen/ without an accompanying update to the OpenAPI spec or generation script

clusters.rule: Guard plugin-specific React Query hooks with an enabled check that verifies the relevant plugin tab is present before firing any network request

clusters.rule: Use Chakra UI numeric token values (e.g. height={5}) instead of CSS pixel strings (e.g. height="20px") for sizing props in Airflow UI components

clusters.rule: Load heavy UI libraries (e.g. Mermaid) through a dynamic import inside the code path that needs them, not as a top-level static import

clusters.rule: Type Google hook method parameters with the concrete Google Cloud client library types instead of widening them to `Any`
clusters.trigger: A Google hook method annotates a parameter `Any` where the client counterpart has a concrete type (e.g. `types.DeleteAgentEngineConfigOrDict`)

clusters.rule: Apply an operator's passthrough config dict (e.g. `extra_config`) last - after every field derived from top-level parameters - so it genuinely wins for overlapping keys as documented
clusters.trigger: A passthrough dict is merged into the API-representation dict before top-level params (`schema_fields`, `max_bad_records`) are assigned onto the constructed object

clusters.rule: Do not add a boolean opt-in flag whose only effect is the format of the value `execute()` returns when the previous value is still pushed to its own named XCom key
clusters.trigger: A new `__init__` boolean parameter (e.g. `return_gcs_uris`) that only switches the return-value format while the legacy value remains available under a separate XCom key

clusters.rule: In a trigger, filter a bulk list result that is already in scope instead of issuing one API request per item
clusters.trigger: A comprehension inside a trigger awaits `self.hook.get_<resource>(name=...)` once per name when a `list_<resources>()` result for the same namespace/selector has already been awaited

clusters.rule: Add new optional parameters to an existing provider hook or operator `__init__` as keyword-only arguments, after a `*` separator
clusters.trigger: A new optional parameter is inserted positionally into an existing `__init__` signature with no preceding `*`

clusters.rule: Do not add module-level imports to `airflow.sdk.configuration` that defeat the lazy `conf` object; heavy or provider-touching imports belong inside `initialize_config()` or `__init__`
clusters.trigger: A top-level import of `ProvidersManagerTaskRuntime` or another provider-manager/heavy module added to `airflow.sdk.configuration` module scope

clusters.rule: `ResumableMixin.external_id_key` must be documented as the stable contract shared between an operator and its trigger, including the naming convention (`<provider>_<resource>_id`)
clusters.trigger: A `ResumableMixin`/`ResumableJobMixin` subclass overrides `external_id_key` with no docstring or comment explaining its cross-component role

clusters.rule: Abstract `BaseStateBackend.serialize_*_to_ref` / `deserialize_*_from_ref` methods must document the JSON encoding contract the Execution API requires
clusters.trigger: One of those abstract methods is added or modified without a docstring stating the JSON round-trip requirement

clusters.rule: Every `@lru_cache`d `@property` operations accessor on the task-SDK `Client` must carry a return-type annotation and a one-line docstring, matching the existing accessors
clusters.trigger: An `@lru_cache` + `@property` method on `Client` lacking a return annotation or docstring

clusters.rule: `Client` operations `get` methods must convert an HTTP 404 `ServerResponseError` into a typed `ErrorResponse(error=ErrorType.*_NOT_FOUND)` rather than letting the raw exception escape
clusters.trigger: A new `*Operations.get` method on `Client` that does not translate a 404 into the typed error variant

clusters.rule: In DAG-parsing and other hot paths, pass log arguments lazily with %-style placeholders instead of calling `repr()`/`str()` before `log.debug()`
clusters.trigger: `log.debug(..., repr(x), ...)` or `log.debug(..., str(x), ...)` outside an `isEnabledFor` guard in a DAG-parsing code path

clusters.rule: Task-SDK coordinator classes must not expose a separate `close()`; lifecycle cleanup belongs inside `execute_task` so the coordinator is self-contained
clusters.trigger: A `close()`/`cleanup()` method on a class that also implements `execute_task()` in `task-sdk/src/airflow/sdk/execution_time/coordinator.py` or a subclass

clusters.rule: `get()` on task-SDK context accessors (`VariableAccessor`, `TaskStateAccessor`, `AssetStateAccessor`) must accept a `default` so callers can tell "key not set" from "key set to None"
clusters.trigger: A `get(key)` method on a task-SDK accessor in `execution_time/context.py` that returns None on missing and takes no default

clusters.rule: Every method implemented on a concrete class that stands in for a Protocol must also be declared on the Protocol
clusters.trigger: A method on a concrete implementation (e.g. `_RealFernet`) absent from its Protocol (e.g. `FernetProtocol`) in task-sdk Protocol/impl pairs

clusters.rule: Every data model consumed by `CommsDecoder` must be registered in the task-SDK schema-versions bundle, whether or not it originates from the Execution API spec
clusters.trigger: A new or modified Pydantic model used as a `CommsDecoder` message type that is absent from `task-sdk/src/airflow/sdk/execution_time/schema/versions/`

clusters.rule: The TS-SDK public `TaskInstance` context must identify a task instance by the dag/run/task/map tuple, matching the Go and Java SDKs, rather than exposing a raw `taskInstanceId`
clusters.trigger: `readonly taskInstanceId: string` added to the public `TaskInstance` interface in `ts-sdk/src/task.ts`

clusters.rule: Yield one outlet-event record per partition key rather than a single record carrying a `partition_keys` list
clusters.trigger: `yield {"dest_asset_key": ..., "partition_keys": list(...)}` in task_runner.py outlet-event iteration
